Endeavor: Deep Sea - Uncharted Waters rules

modules.name: Co-op
modules.note: Every scenario can be played co-op; solo is 1-player co-op.

modules.name: Uncharted Waters
modules.note: Content expansion: more boards, journals, dive tokens, specialists and 4 new missions.

steps.text: Choose a Scenario Sheet
steps.note: First game: Mission 1 - The Call of the Ocean

steps.text: Lay out the Ocean boards your scenario shows; discard mission-specific boards not in it
Shuffle the remaining boards into five facedown stacks by depth
Shuffle the Dive tokens facedown; draw the indicated number onto every zone with a Dive site
Mix the 11 familiar-backed Uncharted Waters Ocean boards into the stacks; keep the 8 special zones separate until a scenario or board calls for them
steps.note: Consider leaving out the Blue Hole Opening board at first

steps.text: Shuffle the Anchor Journal and Journal decks separately; {n} random Anchor Journals faceup, Journal deck facedown nearby
Specialist tray: Tier 1-4 Junior side up, sorted by title into columns (Tier 1 leftmost)
Tier 5: shuffle Junior side up, 3 random tiles in each pocket of the rightmost column
Shuffle the 4 familiar-backed new Journals into the Journal deck; keep the 3 different-backed ones aside; mix in the new Dive tokens and Specialists
Random start player takes the Wave marker
Each player: a player mat, a Team Leader tile, and 30 discs, 5 track cubes, 20 Impact markers and 3 vessels in their color
Track cubes on the 0 spaces of your Attribute and Research tracks
Team Leader by your mat with one disc on its activation circle; other discs in a distant supply (not yet available)
Impact markers near the Impact board
Deploy your starting vessel to the launch zone and gain its Arrival bonus
Shuffle the Setback cards; a facedown stack of {n}
Shuffle the Bonus Goals; 3 on top of the Setbacks; box the rest unseen
Choose difficulty: Beginner 4 goals, Intermediate 5, Expert 6, Legendary all 7
{n} rounds; the Wave player goes first in each phase
Co-op: draw the top Bonus Goal / Setback card at the start of every round, including the first
Round 1 Preparation: recruit a Specialist, gain discs (Effort), reassign
